prompt:
A Berlin bicycle lane seen from behind, vertical frame. The young man in the
navy blue polo shirt, beige chinos and white leather sneakers walks in the
middle of the red strip, seen from behind, unaware. ONE cyclist is close
behind him and slightly to the left, a woman in a dark jacket, upright in the
saddle, her thumb on the bell, her mouth open, calling out at him. A second
cyclist is much further down the lane, small. The lane is otherwise clear.
FAR AHEAD, at the end of the street, a crossing: a pedestrian traffic light
on a grey pole stands at the kerb, small with distance but clearly there, and
the white bars of a zebra crossing lie across the road beside it. The pale
cream facade runs along the right with three or four black city bicycles
leaning against the wall, well spaced.
Daylight, overcast and flat.
